# Claude Code Environment Variables: Agents and Teams

These 88 environment variables of Claude Code `2.1.303` cover subagents, teams, background tasks, and workers.
A subagent is a helper that Claude Code starts for a part of a task.
An environment variable is a named setting that you put in your shell or in the `env` key of `settings.json`.

## Example

Run `export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1` before `claude` to turn off background tasks.
Or put `{ "env": { "CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS": "1" } }` in `~/.claude/settings.json`.

## Variables

The marks are explained on the [index](Claude-Code-Env-Vars#marks).

| Name | Mark | What It Does | Value | Where It Works |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CLAUDE_AGENTS_AUTO_RELAUNCHED_AT` | 🔍 | Records when the agents view last auto-relaunched itself on the latest build. The view skips another auto relaunch for 6 hours. | A number. Claude Code sets it for the relaunched child. The view reads it with `Number()` | `claude agents` view. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AGENTS_SELECT` | 🔍 | The agents view reads it, and a remote-detach start sets it from a value. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off | `claude agents` view. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS` | ✅ | Removes all built-in subagent types. The agent list is then empty. | On or off. Takes effect only in non-interactive mode | Non-interactive and SDK use. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_ASYNC_AGENT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS` | ✅ | Sets the stall timeout for background subagents. | A number of milliseconds. Whole number from `1` to `2147483647`. Without it the default is `600000` with the stream watchdog off, else the stream idle timeout plus `300000` | Subagents. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS` | ✅ | Moves a subagent to the background after about two minutes. | On or off. The code uses a `120000` ms delay when set. It also turns on the worker check-in schedule | Subagents and non-interactive mode. Project `env` can set it before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_BACKEND` | 🔍 | Marks a session that runs under the background daemon. A daemon session handles `SIGHUP` and color output in its own way. | Text. The value `daemon` turns on the daemon paths. Set by Claude Code when it starts a background session | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_CARRIED_PROMPTS_SHA256` | 🔍 | Holds the hash of the carried prompts file for a respawned background session. | Text. Claude Code reads it once, then unsets it. The hash is checked against the carried prompts file | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_ISOLATION` | 🔍 | Sets worktree isolation for a background session. | Text. Else the job or the `worktree.bgIsolation` setting decides. Changes the prompt text | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_POST_CLEAR_RESPAWN` | 🔍 | Marks a respawn after a clear. The session then skips the `--agent` not-found check and the agent prompt step. | On or off. Claude Code sets `1` on respawn attempts after the first when the session id changed | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_RENDEZVOUS_SOCK` | 🔍 | Gives the path of the rendezvous socket for a background session. The session starts a server on it. | Text. Claude Code reads it once, deletes it, and removes the socket file | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_SOURCE` | 🔍 | Tells how a background session started. The value `spare` marks a pre-started spare. A telemetry event also records it. | Text. Free text is reported as `other` | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_BG_STARTUP_WEDGE_MS` | 🔍 | Sets the time before the startup wedge watchdog fires for a background session. | A number of milliseconds, `45000` by default. Whole number, default `45000` when unset or `0` | Background sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT` | 🔍 | Holds the agent name of the main thread. Claude Code records it in the session registry file. | Text. Claude Code sets it from the `--agent` flag | All sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_PROGRESS_SUMMARIES` | 🔍 | Turns on subagent progress summaries when the host check in the startup code passes. | On or off. A host check gates the call. Part of a list of host-controlled names | SDK and host sessions. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AGENT_VIEW_RELAUNCH` | 🔍 | Marks that the agents view was relaunched. The view reads it once and deletes it. | On or off. Set to `1` by Claude Code in the env of the relaunched child | `claude agents` view. Not set from project `env` before trust |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_WORKER_CHECKIN_SECONDS` | ✅❌ | Docs name a check-in interval for background workers. | Text. No string match | Unknown |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING` | ✅ | Controls whether a non-interactive session keeps a running status after a turn ends while background work lives. | On, off, or unset, on by default | Non-interactive sessions |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_CALM_MOCHI` | 🔍🧪 | Sets how a subagent token budget adds on top of the start budget. | Text. `forks` and `all` are valid, anything else means `none`. Works with a feature flag | Subagents, gated by a feature flag |
| `CLAUDE_CODE_COMPILED_ACORN` | 🔍🧪 | Forces the bound Slack thread mode on or off. Claude Code then treats posts from that thread as relayed human messages. | Off by default. | `CLAUDE_CODE_COORDINATOR_SKILL_GUIDANCE` | 🔍🧪 | The coordinator prompt code reads this flag next to text that says only workers run skills. Purpose unknown. No visible effect in a print-mode probe ([Probes](Claude-Code-Probes)). | On or off, off by default | Coordinator mode |
